g.title: Localswim V2 milestone workstreams
g.desc: All 39 milestones are placed by their complete documented prerequisite graph. Each target sits below every prerequisite. Solid arrows show within-workstream order. Top labels show entry requirements from other workstreams. Every card reserves the same space for that label. Row positions are relative turns, and independent branches may advance as soon as ready.
g.text: Start after every incoming prerequisite. Independent milestones on the same row can run in parallel.

g.text: Every 3 hours, demo the milestones that landed on the integrated build.
Turn numbers show the dependency batches. Milestones on the same turn can run in parallel.
